paragraphs.text: For I would not, brethren, have you ignorant, that our fathers were all under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;
paragraphs.original: Οὐ θέλω γὰρ ὑμᾶς ἀγνοεῖν, ἀδελφοί, ὅτι οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν πάντες ὑπὸ τὴν νεφέλην ἦσαν καὶ πάντες διὰ τῆς θαλάσσης διῆλθον,
paragraphs.translit: Ou thelō gar hymas agnoein, adelphoi, hoti hoi pateres hēmōn pantes hypo tēn nephelēn ēsan kai pantes dia tēs thalassēs diēlthon,

paragraphs.text: and were all baptized unto Moses in the cloud and in the sea;
paragraphs.original: καὶ πάντες εἰς τὸν Μωϋσῆν ἐβαπτίσαντο ἐν τῇ νεφέλῃ καὶ ἐν τῇ θαλάσσῃ,
paragraphs.translit: kai pantes eis ton Mōysēn ebaptisanto en tē nephelē kai en tē thalassē,

paragraphs.text: and did all eat the same spiritual food;
paragraphs.original: καὶ πάντες τὸ αὐτὸ πνευματικὸν βρῶμα ἔφαγον
paragraphs.translit: kai pantes to auto pneumatikon brōma ephagon

paragraphs.text: and did all drink the same spiritual drink: for they drank of a spiritual rock that followed them: and the rock was Christ.
paragraphs.original: καὶ πάντες τὸ αὐτὸ πνευματικὸν ἔπιον πόμα, ἔπινον γὰρ ἐκ πνευματικῆς ἀκολουθούσης πέτρας, ἡ πέτρα δὲ ἦν ὁ Χριστός·
paragraphs.translit: kai pantes to auto pneumatikon epion poma, epinon gar ek pneumatikēs akolouthousēs petras, hē petra de ēn ho Christos·

paragraphs.text: Howbeit with most of them God was not well pleased: for they were overthrown in the wilderness.
paragraphs.original: ἀλλʼ οὐκ ἐν τοῖς πλείοσιν αὐτῶν ηὐδόκησεν ὁ θεός, κατεστρώθησαν γὰρ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ.
paragraphs.translit: allʼ ouk en tois pleiosin autōn ēudokēsen ho theos, katestrōthēsan gar en tē erēmō.

paragraphs.text: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things, as they also lusted.
paragraphs.original: Ταῦτα δὲ τύποι ἡμῶν ἐγενήθησαν, εἰς τὸ μὴ εἶναι ἡμᾶς ἐπιθυμητὰς κακῶν, καθὼς κἀκεῖνοι ἐπεθύμησαν.
paragraphs.translit: Tauta de typoi hēmōn egenēthēsan, eis to mē einai hēmas epithymētas kakōn, kathōs kakeinoi epethymēsan.

paragraphs.text: Neither be ye idolaters, as were some of them; as it is written, The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.
paragraphs.original: μηδὲ εἰδωλολάτραι γίνεσθε, καθώς τινες αὐτῶν· ὥσπερ γέγραπται· Ἐκάθισεν ὁ λαὸς φαγεῖν καὶ πεῖν, καὶ ἀνέστησαν παίζειν.
paragraphs.translit: mēde eidōlolatrai ginesthe, kathōs tines autōn· hōsper gegraptai· Ekathisen ho laos phagein kai pein, kai anestēsan paizein.

paragraphs.text: Neither let us commit fornication, as some of them committed, and fell in one day three and twenty thousand.
paragraphs.original: μηδὲ πορνεύωμεν, καθώς τινες αὐτῶν ἐπόρνευσαν, καὶ ἔπεσαν μιᾷ ἡμέρᾳ εἴκοσι τρεῖς χιλιάδες.
paragraphs.translit: mēde porneuōmen, kathōs tines autōn eporneusan, kai epesan mia hēmera eikosi treis chiliades.

paragraphs.text: Neither let us make trial of the Lord, as some of them made trial, and perished by the serpents.
paragraphs.original: μηδὲ ἐκπειράζωμεν τὸν Χριστόν, καθώς τινες αὐτῶν ἐπείρασαν, καὶ ὑπὸ τῶν ὄφεων ἀπώλλυντο.
paragraphs.translit: mēde ekpeirazōmen ton Christon, kathōs tines autōn epeirasan, kai hypo tōn opheōn apōllynto.

paragraphs.text: Neither murmur ye, as some of them murmured, and perished by the destroyer.
paragraphs.original: μηδὲ γογγύζετε, καθάπερ τινὲς αὐτῶν ἐγόγγυσαν, καὶ ἀπώλοντο ὑπὸ τοῦ ὀλοθρευτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: mēde gongyzete, kathaper tines autōn egongysan, kai apōlonto hypo tou olothreutou.

paragraphs.text: Now these things happened unto them by way of example; and they were written for our admonition, upon whom the ends of the ages are come.
paragraphs.original: ταῦτα δὲ τυπικῶς συνέβαινεν ἐκείνοις, ἐγράφη δὲ πρὸς νουθεσίαν ἡμῶν, εἰς οὓς τὰ τέλη τῶν αἰώνων κατήντηκεν.
paragraphs.translit: tauta de typikōs synebainen ekeinois, egraphē de pros nouthesian hēmōn, eis hous ta telē tōn aiōnōn katēntēken.

paragraphs.text: Wherefore let him that thinketh he standeth take heed lest he fall.
paragraphs.original: ὥστε ὁ δοκῶν ἑστάναι βλεπέτω μὴ πέσῃ,
paragraphs.translit: hōste ho dokōn hestanai blepetō mē pesē,

paragraphs.text: There hath no temptation taken you but such as man can bear: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation make also the way of escape, that ye may be able to endure it.
paragraphs.original: πειρασμὸς ὑμᾶς οὐκ εἴληφεν εἰ μὴ ἀνθρώπινος· πιστὸς δὲ ὁ θεός, ὃς οὐκ ἐάσει ὑμᾶς πειρασθῆναι ὑπὲρ ὃ δύνασθε, ἀλλὰ ποιήσει σὺν τῷ πειρασμῷ καὶ τὴν ἔκβασιν τοῦ δύνασθαι ὑπενεγκεῖν.
paragraphs.translit: peirasmos hymas ouk eilēphen ei mē anthrōpinos· pistos de ho theos, hos ouk easei hymas peirasthēnai hyper ho dynasthe, alla poiēsei syn tō peirasmō kai tēn ekbasin tou dynasthai hypenenkein.

paragraphs.text: Wherefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.
paragraphs.original: Διόπερ, ἀγαπητοί μου, φεύγετε ἀπὸ τῆς εἰδωλολατρίας.
paragraphs.translit: Dioper, agapētoi mou, pheugete apo tēs eidōlolatrias.

paragraphs.text: I speak as to wise men; judge ye what I say.
paragraphs.original: ὡς φρονίμοις λέγω· κρίνατε ὑμεῖς ὅ φημι.
paragraphs.translit: hōs phronimois legō· krinate hymeis ho phēmi.

paragraphs.text: The cup of blessing which we bless, is it not a communion of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, is it not a communion of the body of Christ?
paragraphs.original: τὸ ποτήριον τῆς εὐλογίας ὃ εὐλογοῦμεν, οὐχὶ κοινωνία ἐστὶν τοῦ αἵματος τοῦ Χριστοῦ; τὸν ἄρτον ὃν κλῶμεν, οὐχὶ κοινωνία τοῦ σώματος τοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐστιν;
paragraphs.translit: to potērion tēs eulogias ho eulogoumen, ouchi koinōnia estin tou haimatos tou Christou; ton arton hon klōmen, ouchi koinōnia tou sōmatos tou Christou estin;

paragraphs.text: seeing that we, who are many, are one bread, one body: for we are all partake of the one bread.
paragraphs.original: ὅτι εἷς ἄρτος, ἓν σῶμα οἱ πολλοί ἐσμεν, οἱ γὰρ πάντες ἐκ τοῦ ἑνὸς ἄρτου μετέχομεν.
paragraphs.translit: hoti heis artos, hen sōma hoi polloi esmen, hoi gar pantes ek tou henos artou metechomen.

paragraphs.text: Behold Israel after the flesh: have not they that eat the sacrifices communion with the altar?
paragraphs.original: βλέπετε τὸν Ἰσραὴλ κατὰ σάρκα· οὐχ οἱ ἐσθίοντες τὰς θυσίας κοινωνοὶ τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου εἰσίν;
paragraphs.translit: blepete ton Israēl kata sarka· ouch hoi esthiontes tas thysias koinōnoi tou thysiastēriou eisin;

paragraphs.text: What say I then? that a thing sacrificed to idols is anything, or that an idol is anything?
paragraphs.original: τί οὖν φημι; ὅτι εἰδωλόθυτόν τί ἐστιν, ἢ ὅτι εἴδωλόν τί ἐστιν;
paragraphs.translit: ti oun phēmi; hoti eidōlothyton ti estin, ē hoti eidōlon ti estin;

paragraphs.text: But [I say], that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons, and not to God: and I would not that ye should have communion with demons.
paragraphs.original: ἀλλʼ ὅτι ἃ θύουσιν, δαιμονίοις καὶ οὐ θεῷ θύουσιν, οὐ θέλω δὲ ὑμᾶς κοινωνοὺς τῶν δαιμονίων γίνεσθαι.
paragraphs.translit: allʼ hoti ha thyousin, daimoniois kai ou theō thyousin, ou thelō de hymas koinōnous tōn daimoniōn ginesthai.

paragraphs.text: Ye cannot drink the cup of the Lord, and the cup of demons: ye cannot partake of the table of the Lord, and of the table of demons.
paragraphs.original: οὐ δύνασθε ποτήριον κυρίου πίνειν καὶ ποτήριον δαιμονίων· οὐ δύνασθε τραπέζης κυρίου μετέχειν καὶ τραπέζης δαιμονίων.
paragraphs.translit: ou dynasthe potērion kyriou pinein kai potērion daimoniōn· ou dynasthe trapezēs kyriou metechein kai trapezēs daimoniōn.

paragraphs.text: Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? are we stronger than he?
paragraphs.original: ἢ παραζηλοῦμεν τὸν κύριον; μὴ ἰσχυρότεροι αὐτοῦ ἐσμεν;
paragraphs.translit: ē parazēloumen ton kyrion; mē ischyroteroi autou esmen;

paragraphs.text: All things are lawful; but not all things are expedient. All things are lawful; but not all things edify.
paragraphs.original: Πάντα ἔξεστιν· ἀλλʼ οὐ πάντα συμφέρει. πάντα ἔξεστιν· ἀλλʼ οὐ πάντα οἰκοδομεῖ.
paragraphs.translit: Panta exestin· allʼ ou panta sympherei. panta exestin· allʼ ou panta oikodomei.

paragraphs.text: Let no man seek his own, but [each] his neighbor`s [good].
paragraphs.original: μηδεὶς τὸ ἑαυτοῦ ζητείτω ἀλλὰ τὸ τοῦ ἑτέρου.
paragraphs.translit: mēdeis to heautou zēteitō alla to tou heterou.

paragraphs.text: Whatsoever is sold in the shambles, eat, asking no question for conscience` sake,
paragraphs.original: πᾶν τὸ ἐν μακέλλῳ πωλούμενον ἐσθίετε μηδὲν ἀνακρίνοντες διὰ τὴν συνείδησιν,
paragraphs.translit: pan to en makellō pōloumenon esthiete mēden anakrinontes dia tēn syneidēsin,

paragraphs.text: for the earth is the Lord`s, and the fulness thereof.
paragraphs.original: τοῦ κυρίου γὰρ ἡ γῆ καὶ τὸ πλήρωμα αὐτῆς.
paragraphs.translit: tou kyriou gar hē gē kai to plērōma autēs.

paragraphs.text: If one of them that believe not biddeth you [to a feast], and ye are disposed to go; whatsoever is set before you, eat, asking no question for conscience` sake.
paragraphs.original: εἴ τις καλεῖ ὑμᾶς τῶν ἀπίστων καὶ θέλετε πορεύεσθαι, πᾶν τὸ παρατιθέμενον ὑμῖν ἐσθίετε μηδὲν ἀνακρίνοντες διὰ τὴν συνείδησιν·
paragraphs.translit: ei tis kalei hymas tōn apistōn kai thelete poreuesthai, pan to paratithemenon hymin esthiete mēden anakrinontes dia tēn syneidēsin·

paragraphs.text: But if any man say unto you, This hath been offered in sacrifice, eat not, for his sake that showed it, and for conscience sake:
paragraphs.original: ἐὰν δέ τις ὑμῖν εἴπῃ· Τοῦτο ἱερόθυτόν ἐστιν, μὴ ἐσθίετε διʼ ἐκεῖνον τὸν μηνύσαντα καὶ τὴν συνείδησιν·
paragraphs.translit: ean de tis hymin eipē· Touto hierothyton estin, mē esthiete diʼ ekeinon ton mēnysanta kai tēn syneidēsin·

paragraphs.text: conscience, I say, not thine own, but the other`s; for why is my liberty judged by another conscience?
paragraphs.original: συνείδησιν δὲ λέγω οὐχὶ τὴν ἑαυτοῦ ἀλλὰ τὴν τοῦ ἑτέρου· ἱνατί γὰρ ἡ ἐλευθερία μου κρίνεται ὑπὸ ἄλλης συνειδήσεως;
paragraphs.translit: syneidēsin de legō ouchi tēn heautou alla tēn tou heterou· hinati gar hē eleutheria mou krinetai hypo allēs syneidēseōs;

paragraphs.text: If I partake with thankfulness, why am I evil spoken of for that for which I give thanks?
paragraphs.original: εἰ ἐγὼ χάριτι μετέχω, τί βλασφημοῦμαι ὑπὲρ οὗ ἐγὼ εὐχαριστῶ;
paragraphs.translit: ei egō chariti metechō, ti blasphēmoumai hyper hou egō eucharistō;

paragraphs.text: Whether therefore ye eat, or drink, or whatsoever ye do, do all to the glory of God.
paragraphs.original: Εἴτε οὖν ἐσθίετε εἴτε πίνετε εἴτε τι ποιεῖτε, πάντα εἰς δόξαν θεοῦ ποιεῖτε.
paragraphs.translit: Eite oun esthiete eite pinete eite ti poieite, panta eis doxan theou poieite.

paragraphs.text: Give no occasions of stumbling, either to Jews, or to Greeks, or to the church of God:
paragraphs.original: ἀπρόσκοποι καὶ Ἰουδαίοις γίνεσθε καὶ Ἕλλησιν καὶ τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ τοῦ θεοῦ,
paragraphs.translit: aproskopoi kai Ioudaiois ginesthe kai Hellēsin kai tē ekklēsia tou theou,

paragraphs.text: even as I also please all men in all things, not seeking mine own profit, but the [profit] of the many, that they may be saved.
paragraphs.original: καθὼς κἀγὼ πάντα πᾶσιν ἀρέσκω, μὴ ζητῶν τὸ ἐμαυτοῦ σύμφορον ἀλλὰ τὸ τῶν πολλῶν, ἵνα σωθῶσιν.
paragraphs.translit: kathōs kagō panta pasin areskō, mē zētōn to emautou symphoron alla to tōn pollōn, hina sōthōsin.
